drhp.business:
Vedant Poly Fabs Limited (VPFL) is a West Bengal-based manufacturer of flexible packaging products, incorporated in 2018 with MSME/UDYAM registration in 2020. The company operates from a single integrated facility at Barasat, North 24 Parganas, West Bengal, where it carries out extrusion, CI flexo and rotogravure printing, lamination, slitting, rewinding and pouching within a single premises.

Products include multilayer LD films (3-layer and 5-layer), shrink films, barrier films, printed laminates, and milk and oil pouches. The company also trades billet strips as a secondary activity. Revenue from operations was ₹11,513.91 lakh in FY2026, ₹8,102.12 lakh in FY2025, and ₹4,953.46 lakh in FY2024.

FY2026 segment mix: Lamination 59.22% (₹6,818.32 lakh), Printed Plastic 31.72% (), Trading Revenue 3.63%, Milk Film 3.31%, Shrink Film 1.29%, Scrap Sales 0.83%. Lamination emerged as the largest segment after new lamination, slitting and pouching machines were installed in March 2026.

FY2026 key financials: PAT ₹1,096.62 lakh, PAT margin 9.52%, EBITDA margin 16.50%, ROE 38.03%. Geography: West Bengal contributed 96.80% of FY2026 revenue; other markets include Uttar Pradesh (1.01%), Bihar (0.75%) and Karnataka (0.74%).

Sales are conducted directly to customers without intermediaries, enabling close coordination with customer specifications. Delivery is managed through an in-house fleet of 8 vehicles. As of FY2026, the company employed 41 persons.

risks: We are dependent on our suppliers for uninterrupted supply of Raw-Materials.

Any shortfall in the supply of our raw materials, or an increase in our raw material costs and other input costs, may adversely affect the pricing and supply of our products with subsequently having an adverse effect on the business, results of operations and financial conditions of our company.
We procure our supply of raw materials from wide range of suppliers depending upon the price and quality of raw materials.
However, our Top 10 suppliers contribute significantly to supply of raw materials procurement.

Raw materials are subject to supply disruptions and price volatility caused by various factors such as commodity market fluctuations, the quality and availability of raw materials, currency fluctuations, change in consumer demand, changes in government policies and regulatory sanctions.
Our business is substantially dependent on key customers, from whom we derive a significant portion of our revenues.
The loss of any significant customers may have a material and adverse effect on our business and results of operations.
We derive, a substantial portion of our revenue is derived from a limited number of key customers.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Key growth drivers included basic metals (10.2%), pharmaceuticals and medicinal products (10.5%), and motor vehicles and trailers (11.9%), highlighting strength in core, healthcare, and mobility-related industries.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Manufacturing activity continues to expand, with PMI remaining firmly in expansionary territory and IIP growth accelerating, while the government's focus on renewable energy, innovation, and food security further strengthens structural growth drivers.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The good news is that amid volatility in foreign capital flows, strong retail participation in the capital market has helped stabilize market valuations despite foreign investment outflows. (Source- https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/insights/economy/asia-pacific/india-economic- outlook.html) PACKAGING MARKET GLOBALLY The global packaging market size in 2026 is estimated at USD 1,220.36 billion, growing from 2025 value of USD 1,180 billion with 2031 projections showing USD 1,443.9 billion, growing at 3.42% CAGR over 2026-2031.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Brands pursuing differentiation increasingly embed digital identifiers that support traceability, consumer engagement, and compliance with evolving extended producer responsibility (EPR) schemes. (Source- https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/global-packaging-market) FLEXIBLE PACKAGING MARKET GLOBALLY The Flexible Packaging Market is estimated to be valued at USD 332.7 billion in 2025 and is projected to reach USD 552.3 billion by 2035, registering a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 5.2% over the forecast period.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: As the food and beverage industry continues to innovate, flexible packaging will play an integral role in meeting evolving consumer expectations. (Source- https://www.futuremarketinsights.com/reports/flexible-packaging-market) MONO-MATERIAL PACKAGING INDUSTRY GLOBALLY In 2025, the global mono-material packaging market is valued at USD 4.9 billion and is likely to reach USD 7.8 billion by 2035, growing at a CAGR of 4.8%.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Advances in high-performance mono-material films and recycling technologies are accelerating this shift, alongside stricter regulations and corporate environmental goals. (Source- https://www.futuremarketinsights.com/reports/mono-material-packaging-market) MULTILAYER PACKAGING INDUSTRY GLOBALLY The global multilayer flexible packaging market is estimated to reach USD 283.55 billion by 2034, up from USD 168.92 billion in 2024, at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 5.32% from 2025 to 2034.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Additionally, the growth of the food and beverage industry and the changing consumer lifestyles as well as the e-commerce growth along with the innovations in the printing and design technologies is also projected to contribute to the growth of the market in the near future. (Source- https://www.towardspackaging.com/insights/multilayer-flexible-packaging-market-sizing) MILK PACKAGING INDUSTRY GLOBALLY The milk packaging market is forecasted to expand from USD 56.12 billion in 2026 to USD 85.22 billion by 2035, growing at a CAGR of 4.75% from 2026 to 2035.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Preference for Sustainable Options • Consumers are increasingly favoring packaging solutions that minimize environmental impact, prompting manufacturers to adopt eco-friendly materials and designs. (Source- https://www.towardspackaging.com/insights/milk-packaging-market-sizing) PACKAGING INDUSTRY IN INDIA The India packaging market size is valued at USD 101.12 billion in 2025 and is forecast to reach USD 169.73 billion by 2030, advancing at a 10.73% CAGR.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Competition is also intensifying in bottle-to-bottle PET where joint ventures between global resin majors and local recyclers are scaling facilities close to Western and Southern manufacturing hubs. (Source- https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/packaging-industry-in-india) FLEXIBLE PACKAGING MARKET IN INDIA The India Flexible Packaging Market size is worth USD 20.41 Billion in 2025, growing at an 11.46% CAGR and is forecast to hit USD 35.11 Billion by 2030. • The increasing demand for lightweight and convenient packaging solutions is a primary driver, as consumers seek products that are easy to handle and store.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: As the Indian market continues to show strong demand for these packaging products, manufacturers are strategically scaling up their operations to capitalize on this trend and maintain a competitive edge in the region. (Source- https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/india-flexible-packaging-market) MONO-MATERIAL PACKAGING MARKET IN INDIA In 2025, the global mono-material packaging market is valued at USD 4.9 billion and is likely to reach USD 7.8 billion by 2035, growing at a CAGR of 4.8%.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Demand for the multilayer flexible packaging market in India remains strongest among packaged food brands and healthcare manufacturers seeking dependable and cost-effective packaging. (Source- https://www.futuremarketinsights.com/reports/multilayer-flexible-packaging-market) MILK PACKAGING INDUSTRY IN INDIA India milk packaging market is advancing at a 6.3% CAGR, supported by growing dairy consumption and increased awareness of packaging hygiene.

overview.business_model:
Vedant Poly Fabs Limited (VPFL) is a West Bengal-based manufacturer of flexible packaging products, incorporated in 2018 with MSME/UDYAM registration in 2020. The company operates from a single integrated facility at Barasat, North 24 Parganas, West Bengal, where it carries out extrusion, CI flexo and rotogravure printing, lamination, slitting, rewinding and pouching within a single premises.

Products include multilayer LD films (3-layer and 5-layer), shrink films, barrier films, printed laminates, and milk and oil pouches. The company also trades billet strips as a secondary activity. Revenue from operations was ₹11,513.91 lakh in FY2026, ₹8,102.12 lakh in FY2025, and ₹4,953.46 lakh in FY2024.

FY2026 segment mix: Lamination 59.22% (₹6,818.32 lakh), Printed Plastic 31.72% (), Trading Revenue 3.63%, Milk Film 3.31%, Shrink Film 1.29%, Scrap Sales 0.83%. Lamination emerged as the largest segment after new lamination, slitting and pouching machines were installed in March 2026.

FY2026 key financials: PAT ₹1,096.62 lakh, PAT margin 9.52%, EBITDA margin 16.50%, ROE 38.03%. Geography: West Bengal contributed 96.80% of FY2026 revenue; other markets include Uttar Pradesh (1.01%), Bihar (0.75%) and Karnataka (0.74%).

Sales are conducted directly to customers without intermediaries, enabling close coordination with customer specifications. Delivery is managed through an in-house fleet of 8 vehicles. As of FY2026, the company employed 41 persons.
overview.business_overview:
Our Company was originally incorporated on December 10, 2018 as a Private Limited Company in the name and style of “Vedant Poly Fabs Private Limited” under the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 vide Certificate of Incorporation bearing CIN: U25209WB2018PTC229187 issued by the Registrar of Companies, Kolkata. Further, our Company was converted into a Public Limited Company pursuant to Special Resolution passed by the shareholders of our Company at the Extra- Ordinary General Meeting held on August 07, 2025, and consequently the name of our Company was changed from “Vedant Poly Fabs Private Limited” to “Vedant Poly Fabs Limited” and a fresh certificate of incorporation dated August 21, 2025 pursuant to conversion from Private Limited Company to Public Limited Company was issued by the Registrar of Companies, Central Registration Centre bearing CIN:

U25209WB2018PLC229187. For details of change in the name of our Company and address of registered office of our Company, see “History and Certain Corporate Matters” - Change in the Registered Office of our Company on Page No. 232 of this Draft Red Herring Prospectus. We are engaged in the manufacturing of flexible packaging materials and operate as a business-to-business (B2B) supplier to customers across India. Our product portfolio includes multilayer Low-Density (LD) films such as 3-layer and 5-layer films, shrink films, barrier films, printed laminates, and milk and oil pouches. These products are used for packaging applications across industries, including food and beverages and other consumer products.

composition and printing requirements. Our operations are carried out through multiple stages such as extrusion, printing, lamination, slitting and pouching at our manufacturing facility.

Our facility is equipped with the necessary machinery to undertake these processes within our premises, including multilayer extrusion machines and printing machines such as CI (Central Impression) flexo and rotogravure. This enables us to carry out manufacturing activities in an integrated manner and cater to varied product requirements.

Our products are supplied to customers for packaging and distribution of their products across various industries. Our business model involves direct interaction with customers to understand their packaging requirements. We generally receive orders through verbal communications from customers and undertake manufacturing based on the specifications communicated by them, including product dimensions, material composition, printing requirements, quantities and delivery schedules. In addition to our manufacturing operations, we are also engaged in the trading of billet strips, which are used across industries such as engineering, fabrication and manufacturing. Our trading activities are undertaken on a bill-to-ship basis, wherein materials are supplied directly from vendors to customers based on customer requirements, without maintaining inventory at our facility.
overview.one_liner: Vedant Poly Fabs manufactures multilayer LD films, printed laminates and pouches at a single integrated facility in Barasat, West Bengal.
products: Printed laminates (CI flexo and rotogravure printing)
strengths_stated: Integrated single-facility operations spanning extrusion, printing, lamination, slitting and pouching allow production coordination across stages and alignment with varied customer specifications.
Location in Barasat, West Bengal provides proximity to raw material suppliers and connectivity via road and rail to eastern Indian markets, enabling shorter lead times and faster order fulfilment.

Diversified flexible packaging portfolio (multilayer LD films, printed laminates, pouches, aluminium foil laminates) reduces dependence on any single product category and allows customisation by size, thickness, composition and printing.

In-house transportation fleet of 8 vehicles gives operational control over delivery scheduling, reduces third-party logistics costs and supports faster turnaround for urgent or coordinated multi-order deliveries.
Direct sales model without distributors enables close engagement with customer requirements, better alignment on product specifications and timely response to order execution needs.
